description_en: Queries one or more SAP HANA backups that meet the specified conditions
description_zh: 查询一个或多个符合条件的SAP HANA备份
name: DescribeHanaBackupsAsync

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup vault
parameters.name: vault_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAP HANA instance
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页页码，从1开始，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 99. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，最小值为1，最大值为99，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The recovery mode. Valid values:

RECOVERY_TO_MOST_RECENT: restores the database to the recently available state to which the database has been backed up.
RECOVERY_TO_POINT_IN_TIME: restores the database to a specified point in time.
RECOVERY_TO_SPECIFIC_BACKUP: restores the database to a specified backup.
RECOVERY_TO_LOG_POSITION: restores the database to a specified log position
parameters.help_zh:
恢复方式。
RECOVERY_TO_MOST_RECENT： 最近时间，将数据库恢复到已备份的最近可用状态。
RECOVERY_TO_POINT_IN_TIME：指定时间，将数据库恢复到特定时间点。
RECOVERY_TO_SPECIFIC_BACKUP：指定备份，将数据库恢复到指定的数据库备份。
RECOVERY_TO_LOG_POSITION：日志位置，将数据库还原到指定日志位置
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en: The point in time to which you want to restore the database. This parameter is valid only if you set the Mode parameter to RECOVERY_TO_POINT_IN_TIME. Cloud Backup restores the database to a state closest to the specified point in time
parameters.help_zh: 选择需要恢复到的时间点。仅选择RECOVERY_TO_POINT_IN_TIME恢复方式时有效，系统会将数据库恢复到离这个时间最近的状态
parameters.name: recovery_point_in_time

parameters.help_en: The log position to which you want to restore the database. This parameter is valid only if you set the Mode parameter to RECOVERY_TO_LOG_POSITION
parameters.help_zh: 日志位置，仅选择RECOVERY_TO_LOG_POSITION恢复方式时有效
parameters.name: log_position

parameters.help_en: The ID of the volume that you want to restore. This parameter is valid only if you set the Mode parameter to RECOVERY_TO_LOG_POSITION
parameters.help_zh: 要恢复的Volume ID。仅选择RECOVERY_TO_LOG_POSITION恢复方式时有效
parameters.name: volume_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to restore the database to a different instance.

true: restores the database to a different instance.
false: restores the database within the same instance
parameters.help_zh:
是否是跨实例恢复。

true：跨实例恢复
false：非跨实例恢复
parameters.name: system_copy

parameters.help_en: The name of the source system. This parameter specifies the name of the source database that you want to restore. You must set the parameter in the `<Source database name>@SID` format
parameters.help_zh: 源系统名。表示需要恢复的源数据库名，格式为`源数据库名@SID`
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source SAP HANA instance
parameters.name: source_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include differential backups in the query results. Valid values:

true: includes differential backups.
false: excludes differential backups
parameters.help_zh:
是否包括差异备份。
true：包括差异备份
false：不包括差异备份
parameters.name: include_differential

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include incremental backups in the query results. Valid values:

true: includes incremental backups.
false: excludes incremental backups
parameters.help_zh:
是否包括增量备份。
true：包括增量备份
false：不包括增量备份
parameters.name: include_incremental

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include log backups in the query results. Valid values:

true: includes log backups.
false: excludes log backups
parameters.help_zh:
是否包括日志备份。
true：包括日志备份
false：不包括日志备份
parameters.name: include_log

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether Backint is used. Valid values:

true: Backint is used.
false: Backint is not used
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用Backint。
true：使用Backint
false：不使用Backint
parameters.name: use_backint

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

Code.description_en: The response code. The status code 200 indicates that the request was successful

Message.description_en: The returned message. If the request was successful, "successful" is returned. If the request failed, an error message is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true：成功
false：失败

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous job. You can call the DescribeTask operation to query the execution result of an asynchronous job
TaskId.description_zh: 异步任务ID。可以通过调用DescribeTask获取任务结果
